paragraphs.label: Visit type
paragraphs.text: Discharge after mania, lithium discontinued, olanzapine continued

paragraphs.label: Source
paragraphs.text: Recorded visit, patient consent on file.

paragraphs.label: Opening narrative
paragraphs.text: Patient Zzsample, Foxtrot, presented with a manic episode characterized by decreased need for sleep and impulsive spending.

paragraphs.label: Psychiatric history
paragraphs.text: Admitted on 2026-09-20 for a manic episode with decreased need for sleep and impulsive spending. Prior hospitalization in 2019 for nine days.

paragraphs.label: Substance use history
paragraphs.text: Daily marijuana use prior to admission; patient reports not using since admission.

paragraphs.label: Program course by problem
paragraphs.text: Patient stabilized during the hospital stay.

paragraphs.label: Response to interventions
paragraphs.text: Patient was started on olanzapine 5 milligrams at bedtime and lithium 600 milligrams at bedtime. Lithium was discontinued due to tremor and kidney concerns.

paragraphs.label: Condition at discharge
paragraphs.text: Patient is stable, sleeping seven hours, and not engaging in impulsive spending.

paragraphs.label: Discharge medications / follow-up / disposition
paragraphs.text: Patient is to continue olanzapine 10 milligrams at bedtime. Follow-up with Dr. Nguyen at the clinic in ten days, and a blood test is scheduled on that day. Disposition is stable for discharge home with the patient's wife.

paragraphs.label: Level of care
paragraphs.text: Stable for discharge home with wife.

paragraphs.label: Follow-up / referrals
paragraphs.text: Follow up with Dr. Nguyen at the clinic in ten days, and a blood test on that day.
